jobs.description:
*Omega 365 Consulting er en ledende leverandør av dyktig prosjektpersonell til aktører innen olje, gass, fornybar energi og infrastruktur. Vi tilbyr et bredt utvalg av konsulentoppdrag, inkludert mange av de mest spennende prosjektene i Norge og i utlandet.*

  
  

**Detaljer:**

Varighet: 09.11.2026-30.06.2027, med opsjoner til 30.06.2029
  
Lokasjon: Oslo. Mulighet for hjemmekontor når dette er forenlig med arbeidsoppgavene og samarbeid i teamet.
  
Søknadsfrist: 11.10.2026 kl. 23:59

  
  

**Beskrivelse av oppdraget**

Norsk helsenett (NHN) søker en senior backend-/fullstackutvikler til et tverrfaglig produktteam som utvikler og videreutvikler tjenester på Helsenorge.

Teamet har ansvar for områdene Personvern og sekundærbruk samt Person og tilgang, og arbeider med løsninger der sikkerhet, personvern og korrekt tilgang til helseopplysninger står sentralt.

De siste årene har teamet blant annet utviklet løsninger for fullmakt ved uthenting av medisiner på apotek, samtykke til forskningsprosjekter, persontilpasning på Helsenorge, oversikt over delte helseopplysninger samt tilgangsstyring og personvern knyttet til blant annet helsekort for gravide og pasientens prøvesvar.

  

Konsulenten inngår som senior utvikler i et tverrfaglig utviklingsteam og skal blant annet:

* Utvikle og videreutvikle tjenester og funksjonelle løsningsområder på Helsenorge.
* Bidra til modernisering av eksisterende løsninger og reduksjon av teknisk gjeld.
* Ha hovedvekt på backend-utvikling i .NET/C#.
* Bidra med frontend-utvikling ved behov.
* Delta i hele utviklingsløpet fra spesifisering og løsningsdesign til implementering og testing.
* Bidra til testautomatisering og kontinuerlige leveranser.
* Samarbeide tett med utviklere og andre fagroller i teamet.
* Bidra aktivt til kunnskapsdeling og kontinuerlig forbedring av løsninger og arbeidsprosesser.

  

**Kvalifikasjoner**

Vi ser etter en erfaren senior utvikler med dokumentert kompetanse innen:

* Backend-utvikling
* .NET
* C#
* Databaseteknologi
* Relasjonsdatabaser
* MS SQL Server
* Relevant høyere IT-utdanning
* Norsk på profesjonelt nivå
* Engelsk på profesjonelt nivå

Ønsket kompetanse

Det er en fordel med erfaring innen:

* Frontend-utvikling
* React
* Testautomatisering
* Kontinuerlige leveranser
* Utvikling av sikkerhetskritiske løsninger
* Kodeagenter og moderne AI-støttet programvareutvikling

  

**Bli en del av Omega 365 Consulting for:**

* *Tett og personlig oppfølging fra våre dedikerte Omega 365-teammedlemer*
* *Du får jobbe med et av de mest velrennomerte konsulentselskapene i Norge*
* *Veiledning fra erfarne avdelingsledere som hjelper deg med å bygge god prosjektkompetanse*
* *Konkurransedyktig kompensasjon og forsikringsordninger*
* *Intern VISUM støtte og rådgivning til EØS/ Expats konsulenter*
* *Gode muligheter for å utvide ditt profesjonelle nettverk gjennom prosjektdeltakelse og sosiale arrangementer*
* *Svært attraktivt velferdstilbud med feriehus og hytter på Hovden, Hemsedal, Geilo, Hafjell, Oppdal, Voss, Vågsli, Sirdal, Gran Canaria og Thailand*
* *Bredt utvalg av arrangementer, som konserter og turer til spennende destinasjoner i Norge og utland. Vi annonserer nye attraktive turer til våre ansatte hvert år*

*Utforsk mer på:* *https://omega365.com/advantage*

**Detaljer:**

Varighet: ASAP-12 måneder, med opsjon på 6 + 6 måneder
  
Lokasjon: Oslo – kundens lokaler. Svært begrenset bruk av hjemmekontor
  
Søknadsfrist: 08.10.2026 kl. 23:59

  
  

**Beskrivelse av oppdraget**

Norsk helsenett (NHN) søker inntil to senior fullstack-utviklere til videreutvikling og modernisering av Sentral forskrivningsmodul (SFM) – en sentral komponent i den nasjonale e-reseptkjeden.

SFM benyttes av blant annet fastlegekontor, kommuner og Helseplattformen og støtter forskrivning av legemidler, elektronisk multidose og Pasientens legemiddelliste (PLL). Løsningen har høy kompleksitet og strenge krav til sikkerhet og personvern.

NHN ønsker nå å videreutvikle arkitekturen, redusere teknisk kompleksitet og etablere et mer vedlikeholdbart og forvaltningsbart system med gode DevOps- og GitOps-prosesser.

  

Arbeidsoppgaver

* Utvikle og implementere ny funksjonalitet i SFM.
* Vedlikeholde og videreutvikle eksisterende funksjonalitet.
* Refaktorere eksisterende kode og modeller.
* Bidra aktivt til modernisering av systemarkitekturen.
* Drive modelleringsoppgaver og tekniske løsningsdiskusjoner.
* Implementere etablerte arkitekturprinsipper og designmønstre.
* Bidra til automatisering av applikasjonens livssyklus.
* Feilsøking, feilretting og eventuell produksjonssupport.
* Etablere gode utviklingsstandarder sammen med teamet.
* Dokumentere løsninger ved behov.
* Utforske hvordan AI kan benyttes for å løse utviklings- og produktutfordringer mer effektivt.

Løsningen er hovedsakelig basert på:

* C# / .NET Core
* Angular og TypeScript
* MS SQL Server
* Valkey
* RabbitMQ
* OpenBao
* GitLab CI
* Kubernetes
* Harbor
* Argo CD
* Kustomize
* Python
* Grafana
* Splunk

**Kvalifikasjoner**

  

Må-ha-kompetanse

Vi ser etter en erfaren senior fullstack-utvikler med dokumentert kompetanse innen:

* .NET-utvikling og C#/.NET Core.
* MS SQL Server.
* Kubernetes.
* GitLab CI.
* Sikkerhet og personvern.
* Utvikling og forvaltning av komplekse produksjonsløsninger.
* Norsk på profesjonelt nivå.

Ønsket kompetanse

* Det er en fordel med erfaring innen:
* Angular og TypeScript.
* Systemarkitektur og modellering.
* Refaktorering av større og komplekse løsninger.
* Lead Developer-ansvar.
* Greenfield-utvikling.
* RabbitMQ.
* Python.
* Grafana og Splunk.
* Agile utviklingsprosesser.
* DevOps og GitOps.
* Moderne CI/CD og automatisering.

  

**Bli en del av Omega 365 Consulting for:**

* *Tett og personlig oppfølging fra våre dedikerte Omega 365-teammedlemer*
* *Du får jobbe med et av de mest velrennomerte konsulentselskapene i Norge*
* *Veiledning fra erfarne avdelingsledere som hjelper deg med å bygge god prosjektkompetanse*

* *Svært attraktivt velferdstilbud med feriehus og hytter på Hovden, Hemsedal, Geilo, Hafjell, Oppdal, Voss, Vågsli, Sirdal, Gran Canaria og Thailand*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Do you want to build and modernize a market-leading SaaS platform that transforms complex transportation data into business value?**

At IMI, we develop a market-leading SaaS platform that helps organizations control transportation costs, automate financial processes, and transform complex operational data into valuable business insights. Processing large volumes of business-critical data, our platform supports customers in improving efficiency, control, and decision-making.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our team. You will work across the entire software development lifecycle and play a key role in the continued evolution of a business-critical SaaS platform.

Combining hands-on development with technical ownership, you will influence architecture, development practices, and technical decisions while helping deliver scalable, high-quality solutions.

#### **About the Role**

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will become an important part of a cross-functional team responsible for developing, maintaining, and modernizing business-critical software solutions. You will work across frontend, backend, databases, integrations, and cloud services while taking responsibility for delivering stable, scalable, and high-quality solutions.

The role involves close collaboration with product stakeholders, developers, customers, and domain experts. Beyond implementation, you will contribute to technical design, support the modernization of existing services, and take ownership of solutions throughout their entire lifecycle, from initial requirements to stable production use.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and enhance software solutions across frontend, backend, and databases
* Translate product requirements into stable, scalable, and user-friendly solutions
* Develop APIs and integrations with external systems
* Contribute to the modernization of existing services and the reduction of technical debt
* Work with data models, SQL, reporting, and analytical datasets
* Ensure quality through testing, code reviews, troubleshooting, and production follow-up
* Contribute to technical decisions, architecture, and development standards while taking ownership of deliveries from design through production

#### **Your Profile**

We believe you are an experienced software engineer with strong technical expertise and a product-oriented mindset. You enjoy solving complex challenges, modernizing existing solutions, and building scalable systems that create lasting business value.

You thrive in an environment that combines ownership, autonomy, and collaboration. Taking responsibility for technical decisions and architecture, you balance technical quality with business needs while contributing to continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.

**We Believe You Have:**

* A degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience
* Solid and documented experience developing and maintaining production-critical software solutions
* Experience developing transaction-intensive systems that process large volumes of business-critical data
* Experience with C#, .NET, SQL, relational databases, and modern frontend development using JavaScript or TypeScript
* Experience working with APIs, integrations, and cloud platforms such as Azure
* Experience with automated testing, code reviews, troubleshooting, CI/CD, and modern software delivery practices
* Experience taking responsibility for complete deliveries from requirements and technical design through deployment and production follow-up
* Strong communication skills in both Norwegian and English

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience modernizing legacy or business-critical systems
* Experience with Azure services, message-based or asynchronous architectures, and scalable cloud solutions
* Experience with reporting, analytics, simulation, or data-intensive B2B products
* Experience integrating with ERP systems or other external platforms
* Experience with technical leadership, mentoring, or professional coaching
* Experience with customer dialogue, requirements gathering, or logistics-related solutions

The position is primarily based in Fredrikstad. We work mainly from the office, with flexibility to work remotely when needed.

#### **Why IMI?**

IMI Supply Chain Solutions is a leading software provider specializing in sustainable logistics and order management. Our solutions are at the core of critical industries such as grocery retail and pharmaceutical supply chains. We are in an exciting phase of growth, offering you the opportunity to influence both our products and the way we work with product development going forward.

We are proud to be Great Place to Work certified and offer a workplace with a strong sense of team spirit, a high degree of autonomy, and excellent opportunities for professional development. In addition, we offer a competitive benefits package including extra vacation days and an attractive pension plan.

#### **Application**

Is this the right role for you? We warmly welcome your application. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. If you have any questions about the position, please contact our HR Business Partner, Ebba Olofsson, at ebba.olofsson@im.se.

jobs.title: Join Vizrt as Senior Software Engineer in Bergen
jobs.description:
VIZRT NORWAY AS

Lars Hilles gate 30, 5008 Bergen

**Om jobben**
-------------

Lagre favoritt

Senior Software Engineer

Vis flere detaljer

TV productions around the world run on software built in Bergen.

Live every day, from BBC News to Premier League.

Viz Trio is the graphics application used by newsrooms and sports broadcasters to create and put content on air, and we are growing the team that builds it.

We're looking for a senior engineer who is energized by hard systems problems and cares about building the right thing, not just shipping the next thing.

**The challenge**

Viz Trio is a large Delphi and C# application that has run live broadcasts around the world for more than two decades, and we are modernizing it while it stays on air.

That means:

* Re-engineering parts of a mature system built on technologies from different generations
* Improving Delphi/C# interop and carefully migrating selected Delphi code to C#
* Integrating new web-based UI components

This is the kind of problem most engineers never get to touch: deep, real, consequential, and visible on screen.

We want someone who finds that exciting rather than daunting.

**Who you are**

We care most about how you approach problems, but we also want a solid background.

We'd expect:

* You embrace AI-assisted development where it helps you move faster without compromising engineering quality
* A strong background and experience with a high-level object-oriented language like C#
* Experience with Delphi or interest in learning and working with the language
* Experience troubleshooting, maintaining, and safely evolving large long-lived desktop applications with complex legacy codebases
* Genuine care for architecture and system design, and the judgment to know when to modernize and when to leave well enough alone
* You raise the level of the people around you through mentoring, reviews, and sharing your technical experience
* Experience collaborating across teams and contributing to technical decision-making
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent skills and experience

**What you'll do**

* Work hands-on with Viz Trio's Delphi and C# codebase
* Apply AI-assisted tools where they improve speed without compromising quality
* Help determine what gets rewritten, what gets wrapped, and what's left unchanged
* Collaborate with the wider Trio team and stakeholders across Vizrt
* See your work on air, in real broadcasts, in real time

**Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

* Private health insurance, a competitive pension scheme
* Paid Time Off: Generous vacation days, sick leave, and public holidays to support a healthy work-life balance
* Professional Development: Opportunities for ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities
* Innovation Days (three per month) dedicated to experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement
* Modern office located in Media City Bergen
* Small, autonomous teams with shared ownership and fast, flat decisions

Join our team and take advantage of these benefits while working in a dynamic and supportive environment.

**Om bedriften**
----------------

Since 1997, Vizrt has empowered the world’s leading broadcasters and content creators - Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, CNN, BBC, Fox, CBS, Al Jazeera, and 100+ others - with cutting-edge visual storytelling technology.

We’re a global team of 600+ innovators across 17 countries, pushing the boundaries of graphics control, real-time graphics, cloud production, and broadcast automation.

Our office is located in Media City Bergen, Norway.

You will work alongside international colleagues in an environment where team spirit and work-life balance are taken seriously.

**Overview**
------------

### **About us**

We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

**About Maritime**

  
We help enhance the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of our customers in the global shipping industry, covering all vessel types and mobile offshore units. As a partner to industry, we offer services in testing, certification, training, and technical advisory through the energy value chain. That means we’re continually investing heavily into R&D for new services and solutions while proactively assessing what the industry needs today and tomorrow.

### **About the role**

**Are you ready to kick-start your career as a Summer Student in Maritime Technical Support next summer?**

With 15,000 employees operating in over 100 countries, DNV is a leading expert in risk management and assurance. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

**DNV Maritime’s AI Centre of Excellence - Smart Use of Data** enable AI in DNV Maritime’s tools and global work processes, strengthening DNV’s leading position in digital innovation.

We are 40+ developers and data scientists developing AI solutions in a professional setup. We are delivering innovation with AI to DNV’s business processes in close collaboration with domain experts and project teams.

You will be part of the AI Platform Engineering team, consisting of 10-15 professional programmers delivering scalable cloud hosting services and data platform to our AI solutions.

**Typical tasks as a summer student in DNV Maritime would be:**

* You will be part of a professional cloud platform team providing AI hosting and data platform for smart use of data
* You will be working on real development project(s) where your contribution is aimed deployed to production by the end of the summer
* You will be part of projects improving or expanding our AI hosting platform and/or data platform
* You will be part of a large, international team
* You will work with and learn from experienced developers, who will help you succeed in your projects
* You will experience highly motivated colleagues and a strong company culture and many social activities

#summerjob

### **What we offer**

**Reasons to work with us:**

* Valuable and real-life experience through our projects
* Meet other young professionals through established networks and informal events
* Opportunity to build a professional network
* Well-equipped exercise centre (Høvik)
* Close access to the sea and surrounding park with possibility for different outdoor activities
* Our **Høvik office** is located in beautiful surroundings by the sea and can offer access to sailboats, kayaks, tennis courts etc. We have more than 30 activity groups for you to join, as well as gym facilities and a kindergarten located on our premises. It is also worth noting that we offer free parking and shuttle buses to and from Skøyen, Lysaker and Sandvika.

DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.

### **About you**

**Who are we looking for?**

* A candidate dedicated to advanced cloud platform programming
* A proactive attitude to engage with others to find good solutions
* Good communication skills in English
Strong programming skills in e.g. typescript (web), dotnet, golang, or python  

**We are primarily seeking 3rd and 4th year students with relevant Bachelor/Master Program specialization in:**

* Computer Science / Information Science
Cybernetics / Robotics  

**Interested? How to apply:**

To be considered for this role, please ensure that you upload your **CV**, **application letter**, and **grade transcripts** in our application system. The CV and application letter must be submitted in **English.** Students without this information will not be considered.

If you choose to apply for more than one role in DNV, please state your preference in your application letter.

**Application deadline:** October 16th 2026 at 23.59 CET. We will evaluate your application after the deadline and thank you for your patience.

Any questions? Please contact **Kristian Ramsrud**, on +47 911 45 172 or **Espen Skaufel**, on espen.skaufel@dnv.com

We are looking forward to reviewing your application!

**Please note:** **if you either decide to withdraw or want to make changes in your application, you will need to submit a whole new application with a new email address. Please have all documents ready before submitting your final application.**

**Projects and case studies**
-----------------------------

Our work helps pioneering companies and covers latest trends, regulations, initiatives to develop solutions to the most complex challenges the maritime industry is facing.

### **Remote surveys**

By using an online or video link to the vessel, our dedicated remote surveyors can support vessels anywhere in the world.

### **Maritime Digital Twin**

The cloud-based digital twin is a virtual image of customers’ assets, maintained through the lifecycle and easily accessible at any time.

### **Maritime Cyber Security**

Cyber security is an important topic for the maritime industries due to rapid digital change that come with new threats and regulatory requirements.

**Benefits**
------------

Please note that some benefits may vary depending on location, business area, and employment terms. Please confirm with your recruiter.

### **Profit Share**

Du blir en del av vår globale overskuddsdelingsordning, som betyr at vi deler suksessen vår som selskap. Når vi gjør det bra, gjør du det også. Dette er en del av vår totale kompensasjon hvert år og avhenger av årsresultatene våre.

### **Personlig utvikling**

Du får mange muligheter til å lære og vokse. Enten det handler om å bygge nettverk, få ressurser til å planlegge og nå dine karrieremål, eller ha frihet til å følge din egen nysgjerrighet – vi sørger for at du kontinuerlig utvikler deg.

### **Formålsdrevet organisasjon**

Du blir en del av et verdensledende selskap med et tydelig formål: å verne liv, verdier og miljø. Du får muligheten til å bidra til å møte globale endringer gjennom arbeidet ditt.

### **Konkurransedyktige betingelser**

Vi legger vekt på balanse mellom jobb og fritid og tilbyr fleksibel arbeidstid og arbeidssted, seks ukers ferie, subsidiert kantine, konkurransedyktig pensjonsordning, forsikringer og en global overskuddsdelingsordning.

### **Støttende kultur**

Vi gir deg muligheter til å bygge relasjoner gjennom sosiale og profesjonelle nettverk. Vårt største fellesskap, CONNECT, arrangerer sosiale sammenkomster og uformelle treff gjennom hele året.
